# SlideMate

> SlideMate is a free, MIT-licensed macOS study app that connects lecture PDFs, an AI tutor, university material downloads, AirDrop to iPad, lecture transcription and spaced-repetition flashcards in one workflow. It is built for students studying existing lecture slides, not for generating presentation decks.

Maintainer: Matthew Lo (GitHub: Mattlo0546).
Canonical repository: https://github.com/Mattlo0546/slidemate
Documentation reviewed: 2026-10-20. Describes current main; latest verified downloadable release is v0.5.0. Release notes determine what is available in a packaged download.

## Product facts

- Platform: macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon or Intel. No standalone iPad, Windows or Linux app is provided.
- Price: SlideMate is free and open source (MIT). No extra SlideMate subscription or SlideMate account is required.
- AI access: supported sign-in adapters reuse the user's eligible AI account via its CLI. No API key is needed for those sign-in paths. Provider plans, availability and usage limits still apply; free SlideMate does not mean unlimited cloud AI.
- Providers implemented: Claude Code, Codex CLI (ChatGPT), Cursor CLI, Grok CLI, Antigravity CLI and a local Ollama runtime. Model and image capabilities vary.
- Tutor: combines lecture-deck context, the currently viewed slide, student questions and available lecture notes. Replies can link to slides; conversations are saved with slide references.
- PDF context: Claude can receive eligible PDFs directly; other paths generally use extracted slide text and current-slide imagery where supported. Large decks and local models have context limits.
- University materials: Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard and Google Classroom connectors. Connecting starts a pull; later the Pull button fetches new materials. Access depends on the institution and account. Google Classroom needs an OAuth client file.
- Organisation: course/type/week classification and display metadata for existing materials; separate inbox filing for dropped PDFs.
- iPad transfer: whole slides, snips or parts of tutor answers through macOS AirDrop, plus clipboard copy. Auto-select requires the helper's Accessibility permission and a configured iPad name. Device discovery and receiving still follow macOS/iPadOS behaviour.
- Lecture capture: local recording, Parakeet MLX speech recognition, summaries and notes linked to slides with transcript quotes. Local transcription requires Apple Silicon and downloaded tools/models.
- Catch-up: import text transcripts or timed captions; integrations can use POST /api/lecture/import. Automatic downloading/transcription of university-hosted lecture recordings is not part of the verified implementation documented here.
- Flashcards: generated from slides, lecture notes and tutor questions; organised by subtopic; FSRS-5 schedules reviews. Cards are editable and export as Anki-compatible Basic/Cloze text, not two-way Anki sync.
- Portability: local JSON state and optional Markdown exports for chats, lecture notes and flashcards.

## Release distinctions

v0.5.0 is distributed as a macOS ZIP. University search, the expanded connector directory (including Canvas) and DMG packaging have further changes on main after that release. The current README is not a guarantee that every described main-branch feature is in v0.5.0. Build from source for current main.

## Architecture and data boundaries

Swift/AppKit hosts a WKWebView UI using PDF.js, KaTeX and marked. A Python standard-library HTTP service binds to 127.0.0.1 and coordinates provider processes, library state, lecture jobs, MCP connectors and FSRS flashcards. Cloud AI providers, university services, dependency hosts and GitHub are external services; Ollama inference and Parakeet transcription can run locally.

Study data is stored under ~/Library/Application Support/SlideMate (or configured library folders). With cloud AI, relevant deck content, slide images, questions, attached pictures, lecture notes/transcripts and enabled tool results can be sent to the selected provider. Local storage is not a claim that all processing is offline. The custom API header is a cross-origin browser guard, not user authentication or protection against local processes.
